## What it is

The MaixCAM2 enclosure shell with its top radiator grille, bosses, buttons, and connector openings.

## Design notes

This is the main printable body used by the `maixcam2` assembly. Camera, adapter, lens, and PMOD geometry live in separate sibling parts.

## Don't

Do not fill the PMOD pockets or the small front grille clearance under the camera adapter.
